title: Milestone Celebrations
metaTitle: Celebration Venue in Mission Beach, San Diego
description: Celebrate anniversaries, graduations, retirements and other milestones at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach with flexible indoor and outdoor event space.
cardDesc: Anniversaries, graduations, retirements and other celebrations with flexible indoor and outdoor space in Mission Beach.
body: Anniversaries, graduations, retirements, promotions and family milestones can be planned across Miss B's indoor and outdoor spaces at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Choose a seated dinner, cocktail-style gathering, reserved section or larger buyout based on the group, with food and drinks coordinated for the occasion.
